name: ecoloop
description: EcoLoop — Instagram for reducing waste in Markham, ON. Monorepo: frontend/ (Next.js), backend/ (Express API), python/ (data tooling).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c green,blue "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
